# Pull Request

## Summary
<!-- One sentence: what does this PR do and why? -->

## Type of change
<!-- Check all that apply -->
- [ ] `feat:` new feature
- [ ] `fix:` bug fix
- [ ] `docs:` documentation only
- [ ] `refactor:` code change without behavior change
- [ ] `test:` tests only
- [ ] `ci:` CI / build / tooling
- [ ] `chore:` maintenance

## Checklist
<!-- Every PR must pass the firm gate. Confirm each item. -->
- [ ] **README** updated if behavior/usage changed (title matches repo name `fayna-<essence>`)
- [ ] **LICENSE** present (LGPL-3 / OPL-1 / MIT as appropriate)
- [ ] **CHANGELOG.md** updated under `## [Unreleased]` (Keep a Changelog)
- [ ] **Tests** added/updated and passing (`pytest`)
- [ ] **Lint** clean (`ruff check .` + `ruff format --check .`)
- [ ] **Types** clean (`mypy .`)
- [ ] **No AI signatures** — no `Co-Authored-By`, no `CLAUDE.md`/`.claude/`/`.roo/`
- [ ] **No secrets** — no `.env`, keys, tokens, `*.pem`/`*.key`/`*.crt`
- [ ] **Conventional commit** — PR title uses `<type>(<scope>): <summary>`
- [ ] **Topics** updated in GitHub About if stack changed
